title: 1. The package: what a minutes document is, and the ten stages

sections.name: shape
sections.label: The document
sections.content: One container anchored on a meeting record. Types: meeting, topic, fragment (a line range of the transcript with a gist), attendance, decision point, minute (record, discussion or decision), decision, task, reference, open question, process step. The Blueprint has the meeting as root type, four required types and fifteen relation specs: a fragment is about a topic; fragments evidence decision points, minutes, tasks and attendance; minutes derive from topics and decision points; a decision derives from one decision point; minutes, decisions and tasks refer to references.

sections.name: stages
sections.label: The stages
sections.content: 1 topics. 2 fragments, covering every line once. 3 attendees and roles. 4 decision points, with every fragment that bears on each. 5 categorise the fragments (record, discussion, decision-prep, decision, action, off-topic). 6 write the minutes. 7 record unambiguous decisions. 8 tasks. 9 references, with supplied files attached. 10 render the compositions (minutes, decision log, task list, provenance). The owner's list of 2026-11-27 had nine steps; "write the minutes" was added because nothing else produced the minute text.

sections.name: rules
sections.label: Three rules
sections.content: The model points and the tool copies: a stage names line ranges, and the tool copies the words into the fragments used as evidence and checks them again later. Every line is accounted for: social talk gets fragments under an off-the-record topic, with no words copied. A group's own rules are data, not package: a house-rules note and a supplied-facts note in the repository are added to every stage brief.

sections.name: distribution
sections.label: Distribution
sections.content: srs package export gives one deterministic JSON file of 82 definitions (131 KB); srs package install --bundle into an empty repository gives a working process. A slice of a finished meeting carries the package whole.
